stages.name: Short notes
stages.why: Reads the document and writes a one-sentence overview followed by the main points in the file's own order (short notes).

stages.name: Cards and quiz
stages.why: Turns the notes or the document text into flashcards and a short quiz with answers, so the material can be studied and tested.
